title: Duplicate RCSA Platforms: Archer and Piedmont
description: Archer GRC and Piedmont Risk Register both maintain active RCSAs for overlapping business lines. Three business lines have not completed migration to Archer, resulting in dual maintenance, inconsistent control ratings, and a monthly reconciliation process consuming 0.4 FTE.
recommendation: Complete Piedmont-to-Archer migration for remaining business lines and retire Piedmont.

title: Duplicate Change Management: Change Log and Change Risk Tool
description: Every change request is entered into both Change Log (BMC Remedy) and Change Risk Tool (ServiceNow). This dual-entry consumes an estimated 2.0 FTE and introduces a 15-20% transcription error rate. The Change Log was scheduled for retirement but remains active.
affectedProcessNames: MP-007: Change Log to Change Risk Tool Dual Entry
recommendation: Accelerate Change Log retirement by migrating historical data and redirecting all workflows to Change Risk Tool.

title: Duplicate Issue Tracking: IssuesPortal and Archer Issues Module
description: IssuesPortal and Archer's built-in issue tracking module both manage enterprise issues. The weekly manual sync between them misses approximately 15% of updates, and the ERT parallel tracker further fragments the issue landscape.
recommendation: Consolidate issue tracking into IssuesPortal and disable Archer's issue module.

title: Coverage Gap: No Automated Wire Transfer Override Monitoring
description: LossDB's automated threshold alerting does not cover treasury wire transfer exceptions above $5M. This gap forces a daily manual compensating control (MP-002) that relies on James Patel's personal review. No backup process exists if James is unavailable.
affectedProcessNames: MP-002: Daily Wire Transfer Override Sign-Off
recommendation: Extend LossDB threshold alerting to cover wire transfer exceptions and implement automated escalation.

title: Coverage Gap: Missing Integration Between Branch Systems and Archer
description: Retail banking branch systems lack direct integration with Archer. KRI data must be collected via email and manually entered by Rachel Torres, creating a weekly lag in retail risk visibility.
affectedProcessNames: MP-013: Weekly Retail Risk Indicator Update
recommendation: Implement automated KRI feed from branch systems to Archer.

title: Stale RCSA Data in Piedmont Risk Register
description: Piedmont Risk Register contains risk assessments last updated over 18 months ago for two of three remaining business lines. The quarterly reconciliation with Archer consistently surfaces 12-15% discrepancies, indicating Piedmont data is not being actively maintained.
recommendation: Mandate RCSA refresh in Piedmont or accelerate migration to Archer.

title: Stale KRI Thresholds Due to Broken Feeds
description: Three of eight Archer-to-KRI Hub feeds have been broken since the Q3 platform upgrade. The manual gap-fill process introduces a monthly lag in threshold updates, meaning KRI breach alerts may fire on outdated thresholds.
recommendation: Repair the broken Archer-to-KRI Hub feeds and validate all threshold values.

title: Role Overlap: Issue Tracking Responsibility Fragmentation
description: Sandra Williams (ERT parallel tracker) and Priya Sundaram (IssuesPortal) independently track overlapping issues. Coverage overlaps for ~40% of active issues, creating reconciliation overhead and risk of conflicting status information.
recommendation: Consolidate issue ownership under IssuesPortal and eliminate the ERT parallel tracker.

title: Role Overlap: Duplicative Loss Data Validation
description: Deepa Ramaswamy and Brian Foster spend a combined 1.2 FTE on daily LossDB triangulation. Their tasks overlap significantly — both pull data from the same three systems and perform similar reconciliation checks.
recommendation: Automate cross-system loss event matching to eliminate manual triangulation.

title: Broken Integration: KRI Hub Upstream Feeds from Archer
description: Three of eight automated feeds from Archer to KRI Hub broke during the Q3 platform upgrade and have not been repaired. Christine Lee manually compensates with monthly data exports, but real-time KRI visibility is degraded.
recommendation: Restore the three broken Archer-to-KRI Hub feeds as a priority fix.

title: Broken Integration: Archer-IssuesPortal Field Mapping Gaps
description: The API integration between Archer and IssuesPortal misses approximately 15% of issue updates due to field mapping mismatches. This necessitates a weekly manual sync process and introduces stale data risk.
recommendation: Resolve field mapping gaps in the Archer-IssuesPortal API integration.

title: Data Quality: LossDB-to-Reporting Hub 3-5 Day Lag
description: The daily batch feed from LossDB to Risk Reporting Hub carries a 3-5 business day reconciliation lag. This means the CRO dashboard and board reports may reflect stale loss data, requiring daily manual bridging by the ERT team.
recommendation: Reduce the LossDB-to-Reporting Hub feed lag to same-day through pipeline optimization.

title: Data Quality: Change Request Transcription Errors
description: The dual-entry process between Change Log and Change Risk Tool introduces a 15-20% transcription error rate. Discrepant change records create audit trail gaps and complicate change-related risk assessments.
affectedProcessNames: MP-007: Change Log to Change Risk Tool Dual Entry
recommendation: Eliminate dual entry by retiring Change Log and consolidating to Change Risk Tool.

title: Tribal Knowledge Risk: CRE Concentration Calculation (David Krishnamurthy)
description: David Krishnamurthy is the sole person who can perform the monthly CRE concentration risk calculation using a proprietary Excel model he built over eight years. With David's planned retirement in 18 months, loss of this knowledge would leave a critical gap in credit risk monitoring.
recommendation: Immediately begin knowledge transfer and formalize the CRE calculation into a documented, auditable process.

title: Tribal Knowledge Risk: Model Validation Queue Triage (Fatima Al-Rashid)
description: Fatima Al-Rashid's model validation queue prioritization relies entirely on her institutional knowledge of model materiality, regulatory deadlines, and resource constraints. No written criteria or scoring rubric exists. If Fatima were unavailable, the validation queue would stall.
recommendation: Formalize Fatima's prioritization logic into documented scoring criteria and implement in the workflow system.

title: Undocumented Workflow: ERT Parallel Issue Tracker
description: The Enterprise Risk Technology team maintains an undocumented shadow Excel spreadsheet tracking ~40% of active IssuesPortal items with ERT-specific fields. This tracker has no formal owner, no change control, and no backup.
recommendation: Either extend IssuesPortal to capture ERT-specific fields or formally document and govern the tracker.

title: Undocumented Workflow: IT Risk Exception Log
description: Daniel Brown's supplementary IT risk exception spreadsheet captures cloud configuration and API security risks that fall outside Archer's standard taxonomy. The log is undocumented and not integrated into the enterprise risk view.
recommendation: Extend Archer's taxonomy to accommodate IT-specific risk categories and retire the shadow log.

title: Compensating Control Risk: Wire Transfer Override Dependency
description: The daily wire transfer override sign-off (MP-002) is a compensating control for LossDB's missing threshold coverage. The control depends entirely on James Patel's availability and tribal knowledge of override criteria. No automated fallback exists.
affectedProcessNames: MP-002: Daily Wire Transfer Override Sign-Off
recommendation: Implement automated wire transfer exception monitoring in LossDB as primary control.

title: Compensating Control Risk: KRI Hub Manual Gap-Fill
description: Christine Lee's monthly manual gap-fill for broken KRI Hub feeds is a compensating control that introduces a monthly lag in KRI threshold accuracy. The control is person-dependent and only partially documented.
recommendation: Repair the broken feeds to eliminate the need for manual compensation.

title: Shadow Workflow Detected: ERT Parallel Issue Tracker
description: The ERT team's parallel issue tracker operates as a shadow workflow alongside IssuesPortal. It captures data not available in the official system, creates a fragmented view of issue status, and operates without governance or audit trail.
recommendation: Consolidate into IssuesPortal by extending its data model to capture ERT-specific attributes.

title: Manual Reconciliation Volume: Daily LossDB Triangulation at 1.2 FTE
description: The daily cross-referencing of loss events across LossDB, Archer, and Risk Reporting Hub consumes 1.2 FTE. This volume of manual reconciliation is driven by the 3-5 day data lag and lack of automated cross-system matching.
recommendation: Implement real-time cross-system event matching and reduce the LossDB feed lag.
